description: Test suite for plugin management commands in Mattermost's CLI, including add, install, disable, enable, list, and delete plugin commands.

methods.name: TestPluginAddCmd
methods.description: Tests for adding plugins, including success, forced active, no file, error, and multiple plugins with errors.

methods.name: TestPluginInstallUrlCmd
methods.description: Tests for installing plugins from URL, including multiple, forced, and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestPluginDisableCmd
methods.description: Tests for disabling plugins, including success, failure, and multiple with errors.

methods.name: TestPluginEnableCmd
methods.description: Tests for enabling plugins, including success, multiple, and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestPluginListCmd
methods.description: Tests for listing plugins in JSON and plain formats, including success and error cases.

methods.name: TestPluginDeleteCmd
methods.description: Tests for deleting plugins, including success, failure, and multiple with errors.
